channel.title: Patchwork – Patch Notes
channel.description: Latest patch notes, summarized: buffs, nerfs and bug fixes at a glance.

item.title: Infinity Nikki: Infinity Nikki Version 3.0 Patch Notes
item.description: Infinity Nikki Version 3.0 'Of Yesterday and Tomorrow' brings fixes for mobile device quest and event issues, outerwear movement glitches, and dyeing display errors.

item.title: Apex Legends: PS4 Illicit Modification Hardware Ban Notice
item.description: The Apex Legends development team has detected the use of illicitly modified PlayStation 4 consoles and introduced a dedicated detection system. In cooperation with Sony, console hardware bans are being enforced against players using modified hardware. Console players are not exempt from detection and sanctions, and we thank you for reporting to keep the game fair.

item.title: Deadlock: Minor Update - 11-26-2026
item.description: Hero base health and bonus systems have been adjusted, along with balance changes for creeps, mid-bosses, and hounds. In addition, damage scaling and summon mechanics have been modified, and a bot drill feature has been added to sandbox mode.

item.title: Anno 117: Pax Romana: December Patch Plans and Year-End Livestream
item.description: Details on recent hotfixes for Anno 117: Pax Romana are provided, along with an upcoming patch planned for December 10 addressing specialists, PS5 crashes, PC shaders, and rival issues. Additionally, the final livestream of the year will take place on the same day.

item.title: Cities: Skylines II: Cities: Skylines II Free Update and Patch Overview
item.description: Cities: Skylines II is receiving a sizable free update featuring new building tools, leisure simulation overhauls, environmental enhancements, and various bug fixes. Players can now utilize new fences, surfaces, biomes, and improved public transport controls.

item.title: Valheim: Valheim Hotfix 1.0.31 Released
item.description: Fixed two achievements that became unobtainable due to yesterday's patch. Also resolved a build UI memory leak and frame rate drops on PS5.

item.title: Eternal Return: 13.2a Hotfix
item.description: The Eternal Return 13.2a hotfix has been released. You can update by restarting the game client. This hotfix primarily addresses bugs such as UI and tooltip errors.

item.title: Hearts of Iron IV: Hearts of Iron IV Patch 1.20.1 & Studio Gold Update
item.description: Patch 1.20.1 brings balance tweaks to Balkan mechanics and bug fixes for the Romanian focus tree. Additionally, the Studio Gold update introduces a major multiplayer networking overhaul using AI tools to combat cheaters and griefers.

item.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Patch 5.02
item.description: Patch 5.02 for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is now live. This update brings gameplay and balance adjustments, visual improvements, photo mode updates, and numerous bug fixes across the Continent.

item.title: Limbus Company: Identity Trait Keywords and E.G.O Synergy Renewal Notice
item.description: Identity trait keywords are being subdivided and redefined into categories such as job, affiliation, combat means, and basic keywords. In conjunction with E.G.O Threadcaste 5 and new E.G.O releases, trait-keyword-based synergy effects are being added. Additionally, Schema Craft UI/UX improvements, boss selection information displays, and the first survey are scheduled.

item.title: Marvel Rivals: Marvel Rivals Patch Notes - November 26, 2026
item.description: A server-maintenance-free patch deployed on November 26, 2026, introducing the new 18v18 map 'Incursion Point' and the 2nd-anniversary festival 'Rivals Day 2026'. Various shop items, Ghostworks Arcade minigames, and the Black Friday sale have begun, alongside hero and map bug fixes.

item.title: Albion Online: Dragonfire Patch 5
item.description: This patch brings Season 35 extensions and Crystal League updates, Dragon Sanctuary and Armory improvements, and various combat balance adjustments for weapons and armors.

item.title: Limbus Company: Version 1.120.0 Additional Known Issues and Hotfix Notice
item.description: Notice regarding bug fixes and hotfix schedules for Schema Craft Beta issues discovered after the November 26 update. Additionally, 1000 Lunacy will be distributed as compensation for the update errors.

item.title: The First Descendant: Patch 1.4.10 Update Notice
item.description: Patch 1.4.10 for The First Descendant adds transcendent weapon loot to 'Wall Crasher' defeat rewards, and improves visual effects and hit detection for certain Descendant skills such as Freyna and Monet. Furthermore, equipment and module errors such as EXCAVA Pulsar were fixed, and numerous UI/UX quality-of-life improvements were made.

item.title: Team Fortress 2: Team Fortress 2 Update
item.description: A new update for Team Fortress 2 has been released and will be applied automatically upon restarting the game. This update addresses an issue where players failed to respawn upon death.

item.title: Team Fortress 2: Team Fortress 2 Update
item.description: A new update for Team Fortress 2 has been deployed and will be applied automatically upon restarting the game. Key changes include an update to Rubikon for mod developers.

item.title: World of Warcraft: WoW: Forever November Hotfixes
item.description: Emergency hotfixes for World of Warcraft: Forever deployed from November 11 to 14, 2026. Includes class skill and talent balance adjustments, dungeon experience and mob difficulty updates, and numerous bug fixes for items and quests.

item.title: Apex Legends: Apex Legends Update (11/25/2026)
item.description: Adjusted brightness and fog settings to improve visibility on the E-District night map. Crypto's drone deployment and boarding times have been reduced, and the battery consumption method has been modified. Various lobby and in-game bugs were fixed.

item.title: Battlefield 6: Battlefield 6 Update 2.1.2.5
item.description: Update 2.1.2.5 rolls out for Battlefield 6 and REDSEC, bringing improvements to the Supply Pouch, UI, AI navigation, and overall stability. Players can experience reduced weapon firing delay after throwing Supply Pouches and various bug fixes.

item.title: War Thunder: Update 2.61.0.42
item.description: Update 2.61.0.42 introduces magnetic torpedo fuses, degaussing coils, and on-the-fly depth charge settings for naval battles. It also rebalances air defenses in Nuclear Escalation, adds depth charges to select aircraft, upgrades DLSS, and fixes numerous bugs.

item.title: Valheim: Valheim Patch 1.0.30 Released
item.description: Applied major improvements related to the Forge of Potential along with various bug fixes and optimizations. This patch affects crossplay compatibility, requiring all players in multiplayer to update their games.

item.title: Mabinogi Mobile: 11/26 (Thu) Update Notes
item.description: The November 26 Mabinogi Mobile update introduces new appearance customization options, bug fixes, and balance adjustments for Memorial Saga Familiar skills. Additionally, fixes were applied to Nightmare Drill, Winter Snack Selection Basket, and Runda Abyss.

item.title: Trickcal: November 26 Update Notice
item.description: Regular maintenance update notice for Trickcal Re:Dive on November 26. Introduces Dimension Clash 2.0 BETA season and Main Story bonus chapters, PC client support, and various quality-of-life improvements.

item.title: Eternal Return: Patch 13.2 Update
item.description: Servers will be temporarily taken down for the Patch 13.2 update. Maintenance will last approximately 4 hours, from 2:00 AM to 6:00 AM UTC on Thursday, November 26.

item.title: Arknights: Endfield: Version Update: Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms
item.description: A maintenance and update has been released for the new version of Arknights: Endfield. New areas like 'Wuling - Old Dam', story chapters, new operators, weapons, enemies, and various events and content have been added.

item.title: Dota 2: Gameplay Patch 7.42a and Bug Fixes
item.description: Dota 2 patch 7.42a has been released, fixing various bugs such as Tormentors, game crashes, hero ability interactions, and item effects.

item.title: Diablo IV: Diablo IV Patch 3.3.0 Notes
item.description: Diablo IV update 3.3.0 is now live, featuring Season of the Horadric Stones events and boss bug fixes. Horadric item drop rates have been increased and their stats overhauled, alongside major balance adjustments to class skills and Paragon boards for classes including Barbarian and Druid.

item.title: Dead by Daylight: 10.3.0 Terrifier Patch Notes
item.description: The new Killer 'Terrifier', Survivor 'Sienna Shaw', and a new map 'Hearththorn Mall' have been added. Adjustments to existing perks, the addition of gore settings, and a rework of the Mori system have been implemented.

item.title: Escape from Tarkov: Escape from Tarkov Patch 1.3.5.0
item.description: The Halloween event has ended and the game has upgraded to Unity 6, bringing major performance, loading, and server optimizations. RenderStack has been introduced to improve graphics and rendering performance, along with Handbook category updates and numerous bug fixes.

item.title: Phasmophobia: Phasmophobia Resonance Update
item.description: Performance and stability have been improved with the introduction of the Unity 6 engine, alongside an overhauled lighting system and improved voice recognition. New equipment such as the 'Dowsing Rod', an improved map voting system, and colorblind modes have been added.

item.title: Don't Starve Together: Hotfix 763928 Update
item.description: Client crashes related to WX-78 circuit boards and crashes occurring after defeating the celestial boss have been fixed. Additionally, commemorating the release of 'Don't Starve: Newhome' in China, a Homestyle Firepit skin and 1,000 Clay Points are being given away for free.

item.title: Counter-Strike 2: Counter-Strike 2 Update
item.description: This update fixes various terrains and bugs on the map 'Cobblestone', improves 3rd-person silent reload animation speeds, and enhances overall stability.

item.title: Team Fortress 2: Team Fortress 2 Update Released
item.description: A new update for Team Fortress 2 has been released. It will be applied automatically upon restarting the game.

item.title: Railroads Online: The Kinetic Update Released
item.description: Railroads Online has released the Kinetic Update, featuring a complete overhaul of train physics, dynamic audio, and new traction and braking mechanics.

item.title: Crossout Remastered: Track to the future
item.description: A closer look at the new season features for Crossout has been revealed. Eric Stahl's squad receives an emergency signal showing that the Ravagers have attacked the secret laboratory of the 'Dawn's Children'.

item.title: World of Warships: World of Warships Update 15.11 Teaser
item.description: The teaser for World of Warships Update 15.11 has been released. Get ready for festive activities including a free Tier IX Tech Tree ship, the Ice Station Port, updated Santa's Gift containers, and more.

item.title: War Thunder: War Thunder Update 2.61.0.37
item.description: An exploit involving custom Battle Ratings has been fixed along with temporary bans and rating resets for abusers. Ground vehicles and graphics received minor updates, including radar scope scale changes for the 9K317M 'BUK-M3' and Kelvin wakes for ships.

item.title: World of Tanks: Update 2.4.2: A Taste of the Festive Season
item.description: World of Tanks Update 2.4.2 brings improved battle sounds, the return of the Advent Calendar, and details on the Well-Deserved Reward 2026. Players with a WoT Premium Account will receive an extra 24 hours of premium time to compensate for the maintenance downtime.

item.title: Hearthstone (Battlegrounds): Hearthstone 37.2 Patch Preview — Battlegrounds Season 15: Twisted Empire
item.description: Battlegrounds Season 15 begins alongside patch 37.2 on December 1st. Three new keywords and two new heroes are being added, the Time-Warped Tavern returns, and trinkets are rotated out this season. A limited-time 2v2 Tavern Brawl will also be available. (Based on official preview, final content is subject to change)

item.title: War Thunder: Update 2.61.0.33 Patch Notes
item.description: War Thunder Update 2.61.0.33 fixes a WEP engine thrust bug for Hornet aircraft and updates convoy SAMs at Battle Ratings 13.3 and above. It also adds a shader compilation progress indicator to the hangar and resolves several graphics and system bugs.

item.title: Once Human: 3.2.1 Bug Fixes (November 20)
item.description: The November 20 patch for Once Human reduces the Dissonant Dust gain penalty after the weekly cap, adjusts reward limits for The Echo War, and increases the Resonance Box drop rate alongside various bug fixes.

item.title: Anno 117: Pax Romana: Anno 117: Pax Romana - Hotfix 3.0.1.1
item.description: Hotfix 3.0.1.1 for Anno 117: Pax Romana is now live across all platforms. This update resolves two specific issues concerning ornaments in the game.

item.title: Crossout Remastered: New Developer Blog and Upcoming Update
item.description: The latest Crossout developer blog reveals the new legendary laser shotgun 'Geryon' and the legendary light cabin 'Persephone' from the Dawn's Children. It also previews the reworked 'Short circuit' brawl, a new flag capture-inspired brawl mode, and interface improvements for storage and workbenches.

item.title: THE FINALS: Update 12.4.0
item.description: This week's update introduces new store items in anticipation of the upcoming 2026 Grand Major tournament.

item.title: Marvel Rivals: November 19, 2026 Patch Notes
item.description: Marvel Rivals is releasing new content and a 2nd-anniversary event on November 19, 2026, without downtime. This update includes new store items, Pop & Win events, Twitch Drops, and various hero bug fixes.

item.title: Knight Online: November 18th Patch Notes
item.description: Knight Online has introduced new events such as the Puzzle Event, Full Moon Rift, and Catch the Golden Pig, alongside updates to Event Manager Aset sales. Various system adjustments have been made, including an increased Genie restart cooldown, removed mana consumption in the Discipline Dungeon, and reduced item and Noah drop rates.

item.title: MapleStory: Client 1.2.421 Update
item.description: The MapleStory X Blue Archive collaboration event and the Winter Countdown pre-registration event have begun. Quality-of-life improvements have been applied, including a rework of Intense Power Crystals, adjustments to field meso penalties, and revamps for the boss and game settings UI.

item.title: FC Online: Club Career Update Advance Notice
item.description: Club careers for certain players are scheduled to be updated during the regular maintenance on November 26. The list of target players can be found in the images within the notice and is subject to change based on licensing conditions.

item.title: Counter-Strike 2: Counter-Strike 2 Update
item.description: Various terrain issues and bugs on the Cobblestone and Inferno maps have been fixed. The AWP's slow reload animation has been updated, and an X-ray scanner feature has been added for Swiss players.

item.title: Apex Legends: Apex Legends 11/16/2026 Update
item.description: An issue where the upgrade trees for Alter, Seer, and Wattson were incorrectly placed has been resolved. This update focuses on this bug fix.
